scope: Retained Malmö universe only. No qualified hit does not establish absence from the retailer's current or entire market assortment. Technical unfinished work is never an owner decision.

mynta: 91 original generic raw-edible definitions are now versioned separately from 40 explicit leaf-only recipes. Ten exact cut 25-g product contexts use Matvaretabellen 06.259 85% edible population estimate only in estimated mode, including the two Lund examples. New full checkouts are required; leaf-only and exact-quantity gaps remain. See source-review.json and recipe-review.json.
tamarindpasta: Present as exact Chua Hah Seng article 101674821_ST, 435 ml, seven reference rows. The source is concentrate, while authored quantity is paste grams. Exact-package mass/density and reviewed concentration/seedless composition remain missing. No 1:1 conversion or silent dilution. See source-review.json.
masa harina: 31 authored nixtamalised masa variants remain. PAN 101365159_ST / 7591002000547 is precooked cornmeal; no qualified nixtamalised priced SKU in reference or already reviewed newer catalogue. Specialist retailer products are leads outside this price scope. See source-review.json.
citrongräs: Whole 50-g stems are priced. USDA 11972 has conflicting lemon-grass title and Collinsonia canadensis taxon, so its 35% refuse cannot certify Cymbopogon tender core. Need a compatible trimmed-core yield.
nötkött: All 16 reviewed cut relations retain their original source identities. The four whole tenderloin articles now use the independently observed ordinary 369 SEK/kg rate through the existing quantity resolver. The unbound member cap is retained as evidence and never applied. The 1800-g representative package remains estimated, rounded to whole packs; exact mode remains blocked. No PurchaseTerms or cap unit is inferred.
pärlkorn: 27 variants explicitly require pearl barley. GoGreen 101188530_ST / 7310130002885 is cut barley. Urtekram manufacturer article 1012040, 400 g, matches polished kernels but lacks an exact priced source row. Titles alone do not authorize replacing grain/water/time. See source-review.json.
klibbigt ris: Expanded sticky/glutinous/sushi retrieval contains ordinary sushi rice and prepared meals, no verified glutinous rice cultivar. Sushi rice stickiness is not proof of this authored ingredient.
bambuskott: Twin Dragon Bamboo Shoot 567/300 g and Spicefield 410/200 g are exact food candidates. Net/comparison pairs do not themselves prove drained basis. Existing detail archive lacks the necessary declaration; direct Dabas attempts did not supply it.
räkor: Omega Dabas explicitly states cooked peeled shrimp 400 g, but not the recipe's drained/deglazed edible mass. Other exact 400/200 and 870/500-g candidates still need their own drained declaration. Raw or shell-on shrimp remain separate.
tapiokastärkelse: No tapioca/tapioka/cassava starch candidate found in the retained universe. Pearls, flour and noodles would not prove pure starch.
äggula: Kronägg source verifies approximate 30% yolk, 60% white, 10% shell and separate raw component macros. Safe activation still needs shared co-product purchase allocation, recipe versions, time accounting and measured pantry purchase/consumption reconciliation. No partial runtime conversion is enabled.
äggvita: Same Kronägg source supports a documented population estimate, not a product-specific yield. Liquid-white candidates still need exact mass/volume proof. Shared egg purchase and co-product pantry accounting are unfinished; whole-egg nutrients are not assigned to whites.
rimmat fläsk: Raw cured pork candidates exist, but bacon and cooked/smoked pork are excluded. Tulip source package 8x1000G conflicts with consumer 1000-g net in the current parser and remains rejected rather than treating a case as one pack.
gelatinblad: Manufacturer embedded exact GTIN 5701073066478 declares 12 sheets, 20 g. Default sibling is 10 sheets, 17 g and is excluded. Count remains the purchase package; usable grams are source-projected. Ingredients and nutrition remain unknown.
klibbigt rismjöl: Only ordinary Risenta rice flour found. Its rice flour identity does not establish glutinous rice flour.
tapiokapärlor: No tapioca pearl SKU found under both spellings. Need small dry pearls; starch or prepared sweet boba would not match.
breda risnudlar: Santa Maria 7311312000545 is source-declared 180-g dry rice 95%/tapioca noodles. Dabas does not prove broad flat shape. Instant seasoned noodles and pad-thai sauce are false matches.
kronärtskocka: Monte Castello hearts 400/240 g is the relevant candidate. Whole fresh globe artichokes, marinated hearts and spreads are separate. Need explicit plain drained-heart mass and composition.
makrill: Retained hits are cooked tomato-sauce tins. None establishes the required raw boneless fillet. A raw/frozen plain fillet SKU is needed.
mango: The remaining authored recipes require green unripe mango. USDA generic raw mango yield and ripe frozen cubes do not establish ripeness or the required firm fresh form.
rispapper: Rice-paper/spring-roll aliases include finished rolls. Exact dry plain rice sheets still need composition and usable mass. Both remaining authored forms must retain their separate recipe IDs.
sardiner: Oil and tomato tins are priced. Oil-tin net mass cannot certify drained fish mass or drained nutrient basis; obtain the exact tin declaration.
uradlinser: No urad/black-gram/Vigna mungo SKU found. Black beluga lentils, green mung beans and chana are different species/forms.
vinblad: Sevan 620/350-g source labels comparison as Per kilogram, not Per avrunnen vikt. The parser correctly rejects the inconsistent basis. Filled dolmas are negative cases.
bittergurka: Expanded bitter/karela retrieval produced tonic, bitter almonds and flavours, no bitter melon. Need a real priced fruit plus seed-excluding edible yield.
chana dal: Whole chickpeas and chickpea flour exist, but no verified split peeled chana dal. Neither is a silent replacement.
gröna mungbönor: Eldorado 800-g and Garant 500-g dry beans exist. A documented soak/cook/drain process and yield, cooked-input nutrition and dry-to-cooked inventory accounting are still required. No water uptake or nutrient retention is inferred. Saltå Kvarn gives 8–24 h soak and softness-checked boiling, but its approximate 1:3 increase is volume, not gram yield.
surkål: Krakus 900-g Dabas composition is plain fermented cabbage, but net equals comparison and drained basis is absent. Stollenwerk and Rolnik alternative packs still need exact drained sources.
vattenkastanjer: Spicefield Water Chestnut Slices 220/140 g is found through English aliases. Need explicit drained peeled-chestnut quantity and complete composition; a price comparison alone is insufficient.
avokado: Remaining shape requires firm fresh avocado. USDA edible yield alone cannot certify firmness; mature/unspecified fresh packs and frozen cubes do not establish that culinary requirement.
silkestofu: Yipin 7332040300219 has complete source composition, soft silken identity and 400G net. Uppercase supplier units are now parsed without changing their amount. Firm/smoked tofu is excluded.
kefir: Skånemejerier 7310867511407 source explicitly declares this consumer pack as 1000 g and 1000 ml. New projection uses that exact pair; other g-only kefirs remain unqualified for ml. Original per-100-g nutrients are retained and converted only when ml is requested.
varmrökt lax: Falkenberg plain 125/300-g and Vägga fillet pieces are retained. Skinless boneless usable mass is unverified; lemon-pepper variants do not prove plain fish.
bläckfisk: Only breaded squid rings found. They cannot supply raw cleaned unbreaded squid.
fjälster: No casing candidate was found. Recipe uses drained grams, while supplier length/calibre typically governs usable casing. Need a product-bound conversion and review of sausage design; this is unfinished evidence/design work, not an owner approval substitute.
fläsklever: City Gross Grislever i Bit exists as a loose-weight candidate; Dabas attempt supplied no consumer declaration. Most other liver hits are poultry liver or liver paste. Need the exact raw trimmed pork-liver quantity contract.
fläsksida med svål: Pork-side candidates require exact raw, boneless, rind-on evidence and compatible authored cooking steps. Cured bacon, tenderloin and prepared pork are excluded; current source attempts did not qualify the needed cut.
groddade mungbönor: Plain bean sprouts 180 g are retained, but the exact source does not establish mung species. Alfalfa, pea sprouts and wheat germ remain negative cases.
gröna linser: GoGreen 7310130009792 explicitly declares ready-cooked green lentils, drain/rinse/serve and 230 g drained from 380 g. Nutrition remains draining_unspecified. Zeta candidate has conflicting red-lentil classification and was not imported.
kaffe: Dry instant coffee packs and Mode cold-brew concentrate exist. Need a source-bound preparation dose/final volume/strength, authored time and cooling, and transformed-input inventory/nutrition accounting. Concentrate ml is not automatically prepared coffee ml. NESCAFÉ Classic source gives 2 g powder per 150 ml water, not verified final beverage volume; no conversion activated.
kalvlägg med ben: Ossobuco/veal-shank search has loose-weight leads. Gross bone-in mass can only serve authored as-sold demand; it cannot certify edible nutrients. Need exact source quantity/identity contract.
kokta ägg: Raw whole egg and raw-part proportions do not prove boiled peeled egg yield. Cooking/cooling time, cooked nutrition and measured purchase/preparation inventory path are missing.
mangold: Only beet/red-chard salad mix is retained. This cannot establish plain chard leaves and stalks or their trimmed mass.
matbanan: English/Swedish aliases found Kokbanan, including a representative 300-g pack. The recipe's ripeness and applicable peeled yield remain unverified. Dessert banana is excluded.
matjessill: Abba 7316110003446 exact classic matjes source gives 215-g net and 125-g drained fish. Existing source supplement and reviewed relation are used; unspecified drained nutrient basis is preserved.
mungbönsstärkelse: Mung beans and glass noodles are found, but no pure mung-bean starch SKU. Noodle composition cannot create a separately priced starch ingredient.
musslor: Live shell-on, frozen vongole and canned mussels are distinct. The two authored groups retain gross-shell versus cooked-drained requirements. Neither generic net weight nor shell-on nutrients can serve drained meat.
pomelo: Reviewed honey pomelo gram packs use USDA 09295 refuse 44%, edible 56%, explicitly estimated. Soda and nicotine products are excluded; original gross package and prices remain intact.
risvermicelli: Santa Maria rice noodles and Riscossa/Garant wheat vermicelli are retained. Need exact thin rice identity/shape; generic noodles, wheat pasta and mung glass noodles are not equivalent.
runda risnudlar: Rice-noodle candidates lack explicit round profile/diameter. Flat noodles and flavoured instant cups do not establish the authored round form.
råa räkor: Ullmo 7315638231041 is a raw peeled candidate. Need exact deglazed edible mass and frozen-handling evidence. Cooked shrimp cannot qualify by name overlap.
sattu: Da Carla chickpea flour is found, but no roasted sattu declaration. Roasting would require an explicitly authored and quantified preparation; plain flour is not silently substituted.
svart te: Horse Head Ceylon Tea 350 g is a relevant loose-leaf candidate. Need exact plain black-tea composition, not region/name inference; flavoured teas and counted bags do not prove this input.
svarta linser: Dry black/beluga lentil leads need a documented cooked/drained path. Green/red lentils and urad are not equivalents; no cooked yield or retention is assumed.
vegansk smördeg: Ordinary Pop Bakery/Garant/Findus puff pastry is relevant, but complete source composition must prove vegan content. A name without butter is not enough.
vetegluten: Only a gluten-free bread with Vital in its name matched expanded retrieval. No vital wheat-gluten flour for seitan is retained.
apelsinskal: Candied Oetker peel is not fresh zest. A separate zest yield, source fruit purchase and flesh/zest co-product balance are needed; orange flesh yield cannot supply zest.
edamame i balja: Garant edamame/soybean packs need exact pod-on declaration and frozen process. Gross pod mass is allowed only for the authored gross basis; no edible bean nutrients are inferred.
filmjölk: Arla Dabas explicitly states 1500 g, not volume. The new kefir mass/volume evidence does not transfer to filmjölk. Source-bound volume/density or a separately reviewed recipe version is required.
grapefrukt: Exact red-grapefruit gram packs use USDA 09112 pink/red all-area refuse 49%, edible 51%, as a population estimate. Grape drinks and flavour products remain excluded.
grön matbanan: Kokbanan 300-g representative pack is a lead, but unripe green state and peeled yield are unverified. Generic plantain cannot establish both conditions.
hirs: Expanded millet/hirs retrieval found bread and a prepared chicken bowl, no food-grade hulled millet grains.
kastanjer: Expanded chestnut retrieval found water chestnuts, candy and hair colour. None proves cooked peeled edible chestnuts.
kokosolja: Kung Markatta Dabas gives 220/480 ml only. Nutrition cannot be reverse-engineered into density, and kefir's explicit package ratio is unrelated. Recipes requiring g remain blocked.
majskolv: Findus and Garant frozen corn-on-cob packs 400 g are retained. Need exact gross cob identity and frozen processing; no kernel yield or edible nutrition is inferred.
mozzarella: The two as-sold recipes require mozzarella without brine. Granarolo 125-g Dabas lacks evidence that the net pack excludes liquid. Existing drained mozzarella links do not prove the as-sold pizza-block form.
padrónpaprika: Exact 200-g Padrón pepper packs exist, but applicable trimmed edible yield is absent. Generic bell-pepper refuse is not used.
pektin: Atair 7350053730205 10-g Pektinpulver is found. Complete composition/gel strength remains unverified; a pectin mixture or jam sugar cannot be treated as pure pectin.
popcornmajs: Garant 500-g and Garant Eko 400-g unpopped kernels are exact candidates. Need complete plain-kernel composition. Microwave oil/salt mixtures and already popped snacks are excluded.
psylliumfröskal: Lindroos Premium 200 g and Fiberhusk 300 g are candidates, but exact pure-husk composition is missing. Whole psyllium seeds and rice cakes are excluded. Official Danish FiberHUSK 300-g page declares pure powdered husks; Swedish exact GTIN/variant continuity remains unverified, so no cross-market declaration was grafted.
risflingor: No poha/rice-flake SKU found. Puffed rice and oat flakes do not establish dry flattened rice.
rökt makrill: Expanded mackerel retrieval still contains tomato tins, no qualified smoked skinless boneless fillet. Whole smoked fish would need a separate applicable yield.
vattenmelon: Expanded watermelon/vattenmelon retrieval found drinks, sweets and nicotine products, no actual fruit pack. USDA 09326 refuse 48% cannot supply a missing priced SKU.
ägg: This remaining group is cooked_drained egg. It needs the same boiling, peeling, cooked nutrition and inventory reconciliation as kokta ägg, not the existing raw whole-egg quantity estimate.
